definition: Maintain timestamped power-of-two buckets of ones, merge oldest equal-size buckets when the declared per-size cap is exceeded; count_hat=Σ retained bucket sizes−oldest bucket size/2 when nonempty (boundary conventions pending review).

assumptions: Binary insertion stream and ordered timestamps; precise bucket cap and boundary rule pending
limitations: Approximation error, partially expired oldest bucket and space bound require review
failure_conditions: Invalid window, inconsistent timestamps or unsupported bucket configuration
computation: Stage bucket merges and expiration for review; no guarantee admitted.
